our_interpretation: The condition requires actual use of the Apple integration by hundreds of millions of people, not merely access on that many devices.
The ordinary reading of an incredible amount is substantial aggregate serving expenditure. No numerical dollar threshold is supplied or invented.
The claim concerns gross costs attributable to this usage, not OpenAI's total losses or the deal's net profitability.
The surrounding press-based discussion makes this an estimated cost prediction.

criteria.contradiction_condition: After that adoption is established, reliable evidence shows that the attributable compute and energy costs are small.
